definition: [ שְׁדַף ] verb scorch, blight (Late Hebrew id. ; Niph`al, Hithpa`el be blighted ; Jewish-Aramaic שְׁדַף Ithpe`el burn (up); Arabic IV. be dark ); — Qal Passive participle construct, of ears of grain, שְׁדוּפֹת קָדִים Gen 41:6 scorched by a sirocco, so ׳ שְׁדֻפוֺת ק v Gen 41:23 , ׳ הַקּ ׳ שׁ v Gen 41:27 (all E ).
